info.description: Agento backend API for managing agents
info.title: Agento API

get.description: Get all agents for the currently authenticated user's team with pagination support

parameters.description: Number of items per page (default: 10, max: 100)
parameters.name: page_size

post.description: Create a new agent for the currently authenticated user's team

get.description: Get a specific agent by ID for the current user's team

put.description: Update an existing agent by ID for the current user's team

delete.description: Delete an agent by ID for the current user's team

post.description: Improve an agent's prompt using AI based on user instructions
Streams conversational updates and chat responses via server-sent events. Only requires a message parameter.

parameters.description: Chat stream payload containing only the message
parameters.name: chat

get.description: Retrieve chat message entries for the selected agent with pagination support

parameters.description: Alias for page_size to support legacy clients
parameters.name: limit

post.description: Append a new message, tool event, or metadata record to the selected agent's chat transcript

delete.description: Delete all chat message entries for the selected agent

get.description: Get all runs for a specific agent

parameters.description: Number of items per page (default: 10, max: 100)
parameters.name: page_size

post.description: Execute an agent with the provided input

get.description: Get a specific agent run by ID

put.description: Update an agent run by ID

delete.description: Delete an agent run by ID

Get the profile information of the currently authenticated user including billing details
